//@version=6
indicator("V52 array-sort-indices-namespace", calc_bars_count=32)
type Point
    int key0
    int key1
values = array.from(Point.new(2, 10), Point.new(1, 20))
int fieldIndex = bar_index % 2
indices = array.sort_indices(values, sort_field=fieldIndex)
plot(bar_index, "INDEX", display=display.data_window)
plot(fieldIndex, "FIELD", display=display.data_window)
plot(array.get(indices, 0), "FIRST_INDEX", display=display.data_window)
plot(array.get(indices, 1), "SECOND_INDEX", display=display.data_window)
